systems.country_label: DHIS2 (a health management information system component)

note: No fact: the record says USAID's Afya Uzazi maternal and child health programme (US$18,649,774 committed, 2016-2022) had health management information system components including DHIS2 and a community health information system, without describing what DHIS2 reports, so it is unclassified; the record was withdrawn from the finance register on 2026-10-01 because the money is not chiefly for a digital activity.
